notes.title: Update Patch Notes Mar 03
notes.notes:
[list]
Patch Notes:

[*]Added descriptions to the three modes available before starting a new game. This clarifies the differences between the modes and make it clear that all events are accessible regardless of the chosen mode.

[*]Restored the bookstore functionality to the Nimble Finger contract. Players can now achieve 100% completion in Nimble Finger and earn the associated achievement. Additionally, purchasing the book now provides a permanent +1 boost to knowledge.

[*]Fixed a bug affecting Luna's 'Fearless Serpent' event. The first image now displays correctly as intended.

[*]Various grammar corrections and improvements have been implemented for enhanced readability and clarity.
[/list]

notes.title: 2000 copies of The DeLuca Family have been sold!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871465/c300c1b6f63af5f0f807b33bdc8b6f4b4ece441c.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

I hope you've all had a good few days. For me, it's been filled with anxiety and excitement with the release of the game.

But I'm thrilled to announce that[b] The DeLuca Family has just sold 2000 copies![/b] I'm extremely thankful and happy that we've reached this milestone, and it makes me excited to work on season 2 already!

The game is a bit different with its heavy focus on story compared to the usual adult game, and less focus on quick adult scenes. So, I'm really happy that so many have enjoyed the game!

Also, thank you to the people who have taken the time to review the game. Both recommended and non-recommended reviews have been very informative, and I've learned many things from them.

1. Text-based adventure and money gathering are big factors for some people who have not recommended the game. I have created three modes to avoid that situation, but upon reflection, the wording of the modes is not optimal. 'Full experience' can give the feeling of missing out on content. Instead, I need to provide a short introduction to the modes before selection, which showcases that all events are available in all the modes, but it's just a matter of play style preference.

2. Due to the focus on story, there has been some disapproval from people who wish for more adult scenes. I can say that season 1 was mostly an introduction and building up to the girls and the world itself. Season 2 will feature a lot more adult scenes. However, the story will always take precedence. That is my passion for the game.

I'm looking forward to more reviews coming out! If you haven't done so yet, I would really appreciate it!

Finally, it seems Luna's backstory is what people really enjoyed, so what better way to celebrate than with a happy family reunion image!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871465/9115ab5346da7e332eeec3da67b4392de928233b.jpg[/img]

Those who know, they know :)

Wishing you all a great weekend,

-HopesGaming

notes.title: Update patch notes feb 28
notes.notes:
Full experience: Lucania intro has changed so it just goes from event to event, same as with Freeroaming and Vn-mode.

Access to Lucania town has been temporarily disabled due to no content beside the intro available there. We plan to re-enable and enhance the town once new content is added. 

This [b]should[/b] resolve the Lucia-intro loop bug that some players have encountered. Unfortunately, saved games affected by this issue are no longer usable. If you've encountered this problem, please send your save file to me at hopesgaming@hotmail.com, and I'll address it as soon as possible. The save file will also aid our efforts to identify and fix the bug, as we've been unable to replicate it ourselves.

-HG
